description: The plot displays two separate line charts comparing the training rewards of different algorithms over steps on an “Easy Training Set” and a “Hard Training Set.” In both charts, the x-axis represents “Steps,” scaled linearly from 0 to 500, with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis represents “Training Rewards,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top chart and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom chart. In the top chart, labeled “Easy Training Set,” the blue line with circular markers and a solid line, labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” starts at a reward of approximately 0.0 and rises to a plateau near 0.35, with some minor fluctuations. The red line with circular markers and a solid line, labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” starts at approximately 0.0 and rises to a plateau near 0.4, with some minor fluctuations. In the bottom chart, labeled “Hard Training Set,” the blue line with circular markers and a solid line, labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard,” starts at approximately 0.0 and rises to a plateau near 0.05, with some minor fluctuations. The red line with circular markers and a solid line, labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard,” starts at approximately 0.0 and rises to a plateau near 0.2, with some minor fluctuations.
